c = c[:i].replace(dec, \"\") + \".\" + c[i+1:]\n        elif hc or hd:\n            sep = \",\" if hc else \".\"\n            i = c.rfind(sep); tail = c[i+1:]\n            if len(tail) == 2 and tail.isdigit():\n                c = c[:i].replace(sep, \"\") + \".\" + tail\n            else:\n                c = c.replace(sep, \"\")\n        try: v = float(c)\n        except ValueError: return float(\"nan\")\n        return -v if neg else v\n\n    df[\"base_amount\"] = df[\"amount_str\"].map(pa)\n    notes = df[\"notes\"].map(A.parse_notes)\n    df[\"items\"] = [n[0] for n in notes]\n    adj = pd.Series([n[1] for n in notes], index=df.index)\n    if not adj_div: adj = adj * 100.0\n    df[\"fee\"] = [n[2] for n in notes]\n    df[\"waive\"] = [n[3] for n in notes]\n    net = df[\"base_amount\"] * (1.0 + adj) + df[\"fee\"]\n    if nan_over_waive:\n        net = net.where(~df[\"waive\"], 0.0)\n        net = net.where(df[\"base_amount\"].notna(), np.nan)\n    else:\n        net = net.where(df[\"base_amount\"].notna(), np.nan)\n        net = net.where(~df[\"waive\"], 0.0)\n    df[\"net\"] = net\n    df[\"has_net\"] = df[\"net\"].notna()\n    df = df.sort_values(by=[\"event_time\",\"has_net\",\"file_order\"], ascending=[False,False,True],\n                        na_position=\"last\", kind=\"mergesort\").drop_duplicates(\"record_id\", keep=\"first\")\n    df = df[df[\"event_time\"].notna()]\n    df = df[(df[\"event_time\"] >= pd.Timestamp(\"2025-10-01\", tz=\"UTC\")) &\n            (df[\"event_time\"] <= pd.Timestamp(\"2025-12-31 23:59:59\", tz=\"UTC\"))]\n    df = df[df[\"channel\"].str.strip().str.lower() != \"phone\"]\n    df = df[np.isfinite(df[\"net\"])]\n    df[\"month\"] = df[\"event_time\"].dt.strftime(\"%Y-%m\")\n    def rz(g):\n        med = g.median(); mad = (g-med).abs().median()\n        return pd.Series(0.0, index=g.index) if mad == 0 else 0.6745*(g-med)/mad\n    df[\"robust_z\"] = df.groupby([\"region\",\"month\"])[\"net\"].transform(rz)\n    ie = df[\"items\"].map(lambda x: max(x,1) if x is not None else 1)\n    df[\"anomaly_score\"] = df[\"robust_z\"].abs()*np.log1p(ie.astype(float))\n    df[\"abs_z\"] = df[\"robust_z\"].abs()\n    df = df.sort_values(by=[\"anomaly_score\",\"abs_z\",\"event_time\",\"record_id\"],\n                        ascending=[False,False,False,True], kind=\"mergesort\")\n    return df[\"record_id\"].head(10).tolist(), len(df)\n\nbase, n = run()\nprint(\"rows after filters:\", n)\nprint(\"base           :\", base)\nfor kwargs in [dict(paren_mode=\"loose\"), dict(adj_div=False), dict(nan_over_waive=False)]:\n    alt, _ = run(**kwargs)\n    print(f\"{str(kwargs):40s}: {alt} {'SAME' if alt==base else 'DIFF'}\")\nEOF","description":"Test sensitivity of top-10 to ambiguous spec choices"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1158,"cache_read_input_tokens":32763,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1158,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"762c6cfc-5a53-450d-8725-398bff3ee824","uuid":"d70b4fa5-0746-4141-874a-6adaf963f85a","request_id":"req_011Ccs262Ux5FhtwcvvErvA6"}
